manual_text: T.S. of Mammalian Ovary Ovaries represent a pair of female gonads. Each ovary is surrounded by a thick, fibrous, capsule called tunica albuginea. This encloses ovarian stroma. The wall of ovary is made up of germinal epithelial cells called oogonial cells, They produce ova. Matured mammalian follicles are called Graafian follicles. After ovulation the ruptured follicle is transformed into a temporary endocrine structure called corpus luteum (yellow body), which secretes progesterone. If fertilization fails to occur the corpus luteum degenerates into corpus albicans (white body). The granulosa cells of ovary secrete estrogens.

manual_text: Plasmodium vivax a. Itis an intracellular endoparasite seen easily within the RBC of the infected person. Symptoms: Intermittent high fever with chills followed by profuse sweating at an interval of alternate days. b. Itis unicellular. c. The most diagnostic stage of the parasite is "signet ring" stage in the erythrocytes, within which it appears as a rounded body. d. It has a big vacuole inside, and the cytoplasm is accumulated at one place containing the nucleus. Because of the above mentioned features, the parasite appears as a ring. Note: It is a protozoan parasite causing malaria in humans. When an infected female anopheles mosquito bites a henlttiy person, it injects the infective stage, sporozoite, into the peripheral blood vessels. The infective stage undergoes several rounds of multiplication in liver and erythrocytes.
